standard_prerequisites.name: Value independence of variable assignments for terms
standard_prerequisites.use: Base cases: term values coincide under s1 and s2, driving the atomic and equality cases.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 460-464): if the free variables of A are among x1..xn and s1(xi)=s2(xi) for each i, then M satisfies A under s1 iff under s2.

Base cases (lines 466-506): verum and falsum are immediate; the atomic case pushes each term value through prop:valindep; the equality case carries the three-step align chain (s2 value = s1 value by valindep, equal by hypothesis, back by valindep); the reverse biconditional directions are symmetric and noted as such.

Induction step (lines 508-597): for each main operator the forward direction is carried - negation, conjunction, disjunction, implication, biconditional each apply the induction hypothesis to subformulas whose free variables are among those of A; the existential case constructs the x-variants s1'=s1[m/x] and s2'=s2[m/x], shows they agree on x1..xn (as x-variants of agreeing assignments) and on x (both m), and closes with the induction hypothesis; the universal case repeats the variant argument for arbitrary m in the domain.
The proof closes by induction with the full biconditional restored.
proof_roadmap: Base: verum, falsum, atomic, equality through prop:valindep.
Connectives: induction hypothesis on subformulas per main operator.
Quantifiers: x-variant construction preserving agreement on the free list.
difficulty_reason: Assignment-independence of satisfaction (statement 460-464, proof 466-599): full structural induction over formulas with every base and connective case carried and both quantifier cases carried through the x-variant agreement argument. H3.
